pageDescription: FAS Expedition – Our team of engineers, designers, and craftsmen with a passion for expedition vehicles.
intro: Hardly a team member who isn't infected by the camping and travel bug — our team lives and loves what it does!
subtitle: Allow us to introduce ourselves:

people.name: Andreas Böttcher
roles: Technical Director and Head of Cabin Construction

people.name: Márika Böttcher
qualifications: Diploma in Business Administration (BA) for Logistics

people.name: Stefan
people.description: Stefan brings entrepreneurial and sales expertise, complemented by a generous portion of enthusiasm and reliability. Customers can expect the extra mile throughout their project journey.

people.name: Monika
people.description: Our dear Monika lends a hand wherever needed — always with a smile. Her dedicated support in accounting, HR, and the many small things of daily business allows us to focus on what matters most.

people.name: Nils
people.description: Nils is our first-hour employee. Calm precision defines him, bringing new technical wonders to life. His thoughtful designs contribute significantly to the perception and recognition of FAS products.

people.name: Christine
people.description: Christine is our creative wellspring. Her spatial and color understanding is highly valued by our customers. She also gladly picks up tools herself, supporting the cabin team in implementing her own interior designs.

people.name: Martin
people.description: What Martin engineers is solid. He takes nothing for granted and challenges colleagues with his probing why-questions. With calm composure, a wealth of experience, and above all, exactly the right sense of humor, he enriches the team in every respect.

people.name: Patrick
people.description: Patrick brings fresh university knowledge and plenty of enthusiasm. He's equally comfortable with wood and steel as with CAD software.

people.name: Jens
people.description: Jens brings solid engineering expertise combined with strong IT skills and great enthusiasm for finding the best possible solutions. He thinks in solutions, not problems, and inspires others with his sympathetic and engaging approach.

people.name: Jan
people.description: Jan is our proverbial jack-of-all-trades — can do everything, knows everything, and is excellently networked for everything else. Problem-solving is his middle name, positivity his daily companion.

people.name: Harald
people.description: Harald is our calm center in cabin construction. Unfazed by the bustle of the young team, he enriches us with experience, craftsmanship, and a healthy dose of humor.

people.name: Mats
people.description: Mats is reliably on hand for tricky installation situations or mechanical challenges. With high-level expertise and a spark of improvisation talent, he keeps working until everything fits.

people.name: Erik
people.description: Erik brings commercial vehicle expertise to our young team. As a member of the interface team between cabin and vehicle construction, he ensures smoother integration.

people.name: Tobia
people.description: Tobia ensures that workflows in vehicle construction are plannable and routine. With tireless dedication, he smooths all bumps on the road to the finished product while driving optimizations with suppliers and subcontractors.

people.name: Paul
people.description: If you wonder whether our weld seams were machine-made, you're looking at Paul's handiwork. His focused and precise workmanship forms the basis for premium-class rear carriers, roof racks, and cabin frames.

people.name: Fabian
people.description: Our youngest team member brings not only a steady welding hand. Fabian enriches the team with quick comprehension and a pleasantly friendly manner.

recruiting.title: Join the Team!
recruiting.body: We're constantly looking for reinforcements for our young team. If you share our passion for travel or can imagine being part of the world of expedition vehicles — check our current openings.
